scope: First prospective baseline for 92 section 6.1 M6 opportunity gate; no production optimization
architecture: x86_64 under Rosetta; not native Intel
fixture: N=K, H=0 retained history roots, B=4, 64x64 pages, one exact pre-operation View, Preserve then full memset; beginCurrentTransaction through mutation/seal/canonical commit
state: hit, native-pin, generic-lease and last-use start with two independently initialized exact G0 replicas; single starts with one. Both comparison arms have identical initial replica/reader/budget state
selection_control: One copied coordinator TU: thread-local flag disables discoverBefore before queryMutationBase; no phase clocks, event counters or safety bypass. All other production objects reused. The off arm takes original safe Fresh. Product source and image unchanged

process_samples.failure: Stop scope on wrong bytes/work/image, abnormal exit, timeout or changed input; retain all logs, never overwrite. Repair only into a separately named batch

hit.metric: Process median completed-operation latency; median paired log(off/on latency)
hit.gate: latency reduction lower bound strictly greater than zero

miss.metric: Actual completed operations divided by sum of measured operation wall intervals; median of 20 order-balanced two-pair log throughput blocks
miss.gate: on/off throughput lower bound at least 0.98
miss.limits: Fixed-work native CPU mutation cost, not saturated throughput. Reader, generic lease and deferred HostLogical last-use are separate real blockers. Alias/swap/invalid before/foreign owner/limits retain existing safety controls; no unsupported GPU source added

calibration.metric: Evidence switch off=normal selection versus original product, identical fixture; measured-operation throughput ratio
calibration.consequence: If equivalence not established, report same-image contrasts separately and do not silently grant production-wide performance qualification. No subtractive timing correction or additional samples

protected.reuse: Original public fixtures and real same-dependency binaries; fresh new samples in this package, original 40 pairs/four buckets/250 ms completed-rate rules

preflight: Verify prior source/runtime hashes; build switch image and fixture; two samples per case/architecture/K/arm on both images where supported, plus tight provider budget capacity checks and four-generation consumption. Original relevant productionHandoff QTest safety functions run on original and switch image before timing
capacity: Normal/tight provider budget 2S; include single-Fresh, dual-Fresh and dual-handoff. Record bytes/copy counts, old/new complete pixel checks, Store budget live/reserved/peak, retained metadata at close and provider payload zero after close, explicit reclamation drain. Does not establish all alternate-eviction Fresh strategies
order: Sequential processes only. Rotate buckets each pair and alternate arm order by pair; adjacent even/odd pairs are predeclared order blocks for rate comparisons. No concurrent agent-created build, benchmark or profiler
stopping: Exactly fixed pairs; retain slow samples and failures; performance failure does not trigger optional resampling. Semantic/process failure stops affected scope. Host load snapshots retained, no post hoc exclusions
accounting: Setup, synthetic before creation, exhaustive validation, blocker completion, close and drain outside operation timer and reported separately. No CPU phase clock. Count actual completions, never invert median latency to claim throughput
claims: Each family reported independently, no combined confidence claim. Same-state hit is not a real producer or business trace. metadata >=25% denominator and CP0 required audit remain independent; GPU and M7/M8 not qualified
